DM send/delete now require --confirm; dm conversation warns on private content; removed file-based token fallback so AI never accesses stored credentials (X_BEARER_TOKEN only)

v3.0.4: 修复 SkillSpector 剩余 2 个 finding（按用户建议改为用户自管凭据）

【Lp3】SKILL.md frontmatter 新增 permissions 声明（network/filesystem/env）

【Credential Access (High)】凭据改为用户自己掌握：
- 新增 X_BEARER_TOKEN 环境变量作为首选凭据来源（用户自己 export，AI 只读取不存储）
- _get_token() 优先读 X_BEARER_TOKEN，文件式 OAuth token 降为 fallback
- SKILL.md 授权节改为'推荐自己放环境变量'，OAuth 流程降为备选
- 凭据提醒改为'AI 只读取、不存储、不中转'

v3.0.3: 修复 SkillSpector 安全扫描全部 6 个 finding

【High】Credential Access + Unvalidated Output Injection + Missing User Warnings:
- 移除所有 subprocess token 传递: _get_token() 改为 from x_auth import get_valid_token
- _upload_media_files() 改为 from x_media import upload（token 内存传递，不暴露在 CLI/进程列表）
- x_media.py main() 移除了强制 token CLI 参数，token 改为可选（优先从 x_auth 获取）
- 移除 x_client.py 中 subprocess / AUTH_SCRIPT / MEDIA_SCRIPT 全部引用

【Medium】subprocess module call + Lp3 (MCP Least Privilege):
- metadata.openclaw 增加 permissions 声明: network(api.x.com/x.com/api.twitter.com)、filesystem(~/.x-helper/)、env(X_CLIENT_ID/X_CLIENT_SECRET)

【Low】Intent-Code Divergence:
- setup.py docstring 从 '纯只读检查，不修改任何文件' 更新为准确描述（会发送 API 请求验证 token）

【All】Missing User Warnings:
- SKILL.md 顶部增加 ⚠️ 数据外发提醒 + ⚠️ 凭据管理提醒

v3.0.2: Bug fixes. 1) x_auth.py: confidential client OAuth now uses Basic Auth header (client_id:client_secret base64) per OAuth 2.0 spec, instead of sending secret in body. 2) x_client.py: added _consume_flags() helper for correct --max N arg parsing — N no longer leaks into search query. 3) All search commands (posts/users/news) check API error response before extracting data — prevents credits/access errors from showing as 'No results found'.
v3.0.1: Updated SKILL.md with full documentation of all v3 capabilities across 180+ trigger patterns and behavioral rules.

v3.0.0: Major feature expansion. New: Media upload (images/video/GIF via INIT/APPEND/FINALIZE), thread posting (--text1/--text2/--text3), DM management (list conversations, send, read, delete), Lists CRUD (create/get/delete/members/posts/followers, follow/unfollow, add/remove member), Block/Mute (block/unblock/mute/unmute/list blocked/muted), full archive search (--archive flag). Improvements: 429 retry with Retry-After heartbeat, paginated results with next_token loop, pagination for search/user timeline/bookmarks/likers/retweeters/members/followers/blocked/muted/DM, rich text Articles (markdown headings/bold/italic/lists via --rich), --media flag for tweet post.

v2.0.1: Fixed Articles endpoint (POST /2/articles/draft with correct DraftJS content_state), fixed News search response format (name/summary/hook fields), added max_results and max_age_hours params for news search.

v2.0.0 (rename from x-mate): Pure Python stdlib implementation. OAuth 2.0 PKCE auth, full X API v2 client covering search/users/tweets/trends/bookmarks/articles/follow. Token auto-refresh, zero external dependencies.
